title: Capstone 5: Class Grade Average & Stats Engine
subtitle: Analytics & Statistical Computing
description: Compute class analytics across 2 interactive stages!
starter_code:
grades = [85, 92, 78, 65, 98, 77]
# Stage 1: Calculate average, highest, and lowest score

challenges.title: Stage 1: Aggregate Class Statistics
challenges.description: Calculate class average <hlt>sum(grades) / len(grades)</hlt>, highest score, and lowest score. Print each on a new line.
challenges.starter_code:
grades = [85, 92, 78, 65, 98, 77]
avg = sum(grades) / len(grades)
highest = max(grades)
lowest = min(grades)
# Stage 1: Class stats
print(avg)
print(highest)
print(lowest)

challenges.title: Stage 2: Distinction Honors Count
challenges.description: Count how many students scored <hlt>>= 90</hlt>. Print the honors count.
challenges.starter_code:
grades = [85, 92, 78, 65, 98, 77]
honors = 0
# Stage 2: Distinction counter
for g in grades:
    if g >= 90:
        honors = honors + 1
print(honors)
